requirements.statement: Represent RuntimeProfile as a first-class conservative observed object covering observable runtime/version, repository/Git, sandbox/permissions, hook trust and coverage, workspace isolation, network/external mediation, providers/tools, and explicit unsupported or unobservable surfaces.

Evaluate autonomy from consequence, reversibility, uncertainty, observability, evidence strength, runtime enforcement, authorization, and recovery cost into the six required decisions without optimistic defaults.

Replace permission booleans with subject/work/change, action, resource, constraint, intent-digest, issuer/evidence, validity/expiry/max-use bound CapabilityGrant validation; intent drift and hostile mismatches must invalidate grants.

Keep EffectRequest independent from grants and define EffectAdapter/EffectReceipt contracts that distinguish MEDIATED, OBSERVED, and UNCONFINED effects without claiming prevention or implementing a scheduler/provider executor.

Read legacy effects and authorization state through deterministic compatibility adapters while preserving planning validity, separating execution readiness, and never treating authorized=true as a CapabilityGrant.
Document the landed runtime trust/authorization boundary, conservative limitations, compatibility behavior, and explicit scheduler non-goal without creating a second semantic authority.
